rows.text: Maybe... it's the celestial mural.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The Sky city believes that mural to be connected to Amphoreus's sky, and any weather condition depicted on it will become actual weather.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The mural would reflect Aquila's shifting mood, like clear skies, fog, snow, or thunderstorms... The Sky Priests would gather here during peaceful times and pray to the god for warm breezes and good harvests.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: To put it in words that Grayie and Dannie would understand... just think of it as a massive screen.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That really conspicuous device might be part of the ritual? Let's go take a look. It's dark, so watch your feet.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Heh... Foolish Rainfolk...
rows.speaker: Past Sunfolk

rows.text: The great Aquila has already left a mark of their manifestation among the golden clouds...
rows.speaker: Past Sunfolk

rows.text: The god's choice is clear: Only we, the Sunborn, are the true heirs of the sky... This war is destined to end in the victory of the Sunfolk...
rows.speaker: Past Sunfolk

rows.text: May the Eye of Twilight never close. May eternal daylight embrace the land...
rows.speaker: Past Sunfolk

rows.text: "Left a mark among the golden clouds..."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is this referring to the celestial mural? But we can't see anything right now...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Arrogant Sunfolk, the Titan will condemn your brazen disrespect...
rows.speaker: Past Rainfolk

rows.text: But Aquila, you that shaped the sky... Why do you avoid the pursuit of dark clouds? Are not clear skies and stormy rains equally your creations?
rows.speaker: Past Rainfolk

rows.text: The Sunborn see your behavior as an act of favoritism towards them, and weaponize this reason to oppress my people...
rows.speaker: Past Rainfolk

rows.text: The Rainfolk will not suffer in silence... O god, if you remain silent, we shall have to forge our own weapons and resist the malice concealed under your brilliance...
rows.speaker: Past Rainfolk

rows.text: May the Eye of Twilight never open, and may torrential rains descend forever...
rows.speaker: Past Rainfolk

rows.text: "Avoid the pursuit of dark clouds?"
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Aquila doesn't like rainstorms...? It seems a little hard to believe, but we should write this clue down first.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Look, the rainbow bridge has appeared!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Well done. Now we can cross...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hey, careful!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That's...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It looks like a mythical beast. But this one... doesn't seem hostile towards us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ahhh! Hyacine, could it be the legendary...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm... not entirely sure. We might be able to tell if we get closer.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We can't assume it's friendly. Keep your guard up and follow it.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It... disappeared?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: An illusion? Or the memory dissipated?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How strange. That pegasus was different from the other memories. It was surrounded in an air of sorrow...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...It's so heavy that it's hard to breathe.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Was that... Lunabis's phantom? Did it appear here because it has unfinished business?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: If that's really the case, there must be a super strong obsession keeping it in one piece. Could it be some remaining bits of Seliose's will?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We can't be sure of that yet. Let's take the elevator up to the Eye of Twilight's core first.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: A thousand years have passed, and yet this place feels the same — Just that there is no more human clamor.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: This is the hall of the Sunfolk, where the Sunborn once held grand ceremonies to give thanks for Aquila's gifts.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: So... Did the Sky Titan really take the side of the Sunfolk?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Everyone thought so until Seliose's spear pierced through Aquila's wrath.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Only then did we understand that Aquila wasn't hiding from the clouds and rain, but from the horror that lurked within the unlit shadows.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: "Chrysos Heirs"... In our time, that title used to stir up waves of outrage. But you all seem to be revered as heroes.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: It's all thanks to those who came before us — Tribios and Aglaea. You must've heard of these two names.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mmm... So it was those two who made it to the end.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: ...What does that mean?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's not elaborate on unrelated topics. You now know how to activate the celestial globe. So go, and force out the Titan in the mural.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: The road got... sucked away by the wind fan?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Did Aquila do that?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You have nothing to fear! We can use the power of Time to rewind it if we have to.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ..."The turn of dawn and dusk, commanding the celestial globe..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Change, Celestial Mural!"
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The mark... has disappeared again?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Looks like they're still avoiding us. I wonder if it's cowardice... or if they have something up their sleeve.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I fear the Aquila of present has long lost their sanity...
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: But instinct still drives them to flee from the shadows, to evade the black tide's encroachment.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: I have faced down the tyrant of the sky. It is no hyperbole that their raging fire is capable of melting the firmament. Amphoreus's heavens exist because of their authority.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: But I am certain that the will behind that mark is not hers... She would not abscond like a disgraceful deserter, willingly exiled by the pursuit of dark clouds.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: A moment please, Lord Solabis. I... have one more thing I wish to do.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...What is it, girl?
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: To honor the pact with Seliose, her descendants spent a millennium looking up at the sky. I believe my countless ancestors who lived for that purpose deserve to know the truth behind her legend.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: If you don't mind us knocking on the gates of the past... Maybe I can peek into this place's history...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You are the ones who hold Oronyx's miracle. I have no authority to prevent you from delving into the past.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Memmie, Grayie, could I please ask you for this favor? I want to show the truth to my ancestors waiting on the other side.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I must unveil the true nature of the legend, so that my ancestors' souls may rest in peace.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hyacine... You're such a good child. Don't worry. I'm here!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The memories surging here are even more intense than at the entrance... I'll gather them up now, and mold them, and mold them...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: ...All done!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Thank you, Memmie. Everyone, please... witness history with me.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The mark of manifestation. It fled to the other side of the mural.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't stop. Follow it to the Titan. Even if plunged into madness, Aquila is still the Sky Titan... We mustn't let our guard down.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heroes, over here!
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Let's keep going and aim for the next West Wind Compass.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Look, the rainbow bridge is leading us to our next destination.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Let's hurry on. Follow Lady Lunabis.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Now... I shall lead you into the Rainfolk's hall.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Ah, Little Ica — why did you run out on your own?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This little one...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Doot... Doot, doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: You're saying... You smell a familiar scent on Lady Lunabis?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: They look completely different, but... Little Ica should also be a winged beast, right?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Could it be...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Doot! Doot-Doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: Truly a miracle of fate. Perhaps, we did leave something behind for this world... Seliose.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Lady... Lunabis?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Is Little Ica your...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Please press on, flame-chasing heroes. I can sense it — the radiance of Aquila shines ever brighter.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Correct. That was true. It was also during her formative years that the conflict between the two tribes began intensifying. The Rainfolk feared the other half of Seliose's bloodline, and never truly saw her as one of their own.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Until... people discovered golden blood ran through her veins. That was the final straw that turned disdain into terror.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: What!? But the epics said Seliose left to live in solitude so she could train her spirit and hone her martial skills.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I never would have imagined that she... was cast out of her tribe for her lineage and her golden blood.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Even so, she did not despair. She met Solabis and me while she was living alone. We hunted and spent our days together, and forged an alliance.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: I think that oath, stronger than fate itself, kept Solabis and me here to watch over this abandoned fortress.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Despite experiencing betrayal and exile at the hands of her own people, she was still willing to set out on the path to slay the gods for them.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Was Seliose's love for humanity truly so... boundless and unconditional?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: Ah, Little Ica — why did you run out on your own?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This little one...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Doot... Doot, doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: You're saying... You smell a familiar scent on Lady Lunabis?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: They look completely different, but... Little Ica should also be a winged beast, right?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Could it be...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Doot! Doot-Doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: Truly a miracle of fate. Perhaps, we did leave something behind for this world... Seliose.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Lady... Lunabis?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Is Little Ica your...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Please press on, flame-chasing heroes. I can sense it — the radiance of Aquila shines ever brighter.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Aquila — they are indeed here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The celestial globe is right ahead... but there are black tide creatures guarding it.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Looks like we can't skip this fight. Let's go get them.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's another one of those devices that can enhance prayers. Can I leave that to you, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: A Titankin that was corroded by the black tide... It seems it's stronger than before.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Before it was consumed by madness, it must have also faithfully served the Titan, don't you think?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: No healer can heal all, especially faced with souls that are trapped deeply in the clutches of pain...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Granting it a dignified end may be the most compassionate act of all.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Rest now, Titankin.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This celestial globe looks complete...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But it still won't start... Is there something wrong internally?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Maybe it's not damaged, but is missing an energy source.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Look there, those massive objects that look like hard drives...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hard... drives?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ahem... Sorry, let me rephrase. Do you see the two structures that are glowing blue on both sides? Some of them are protruding out, not fully inserted into the slots.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: My intuition tells me that they have something to do with the energy source of the celestial globe.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Your intuition has always been good. Let's look around and see if there are any mechanisms...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Heh, that didn't take much effort. The Hand of Zagreus always appears when it's most needed.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lady Lunabis, if it's not too much trouble, please wait for a little longer...?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's you all who have to do the work. I've wandered around here for a thousand years, so this brief moment hardly qualifies as "waiting."
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Furthermore...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Doot... Doot?
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: ...I would like to have a moment alone with this little one.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: They soared toward the mural's dome... I remember that place.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: I remember too, Solabis.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: I've called forth the Rainbow Bridge. Proceed along its path to the dome where the entwined fates of humanity and the Titan must be resolved.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: At the Celestial Mural's dome, we dealt Aquila a fatal blow.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: The Sunlit Wings set the Titan's Wings aflame...
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: The Moonlit Plume sealed the divine body...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: "The battered hero of the sky... pierced the last monstrous eye."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It seems that the legend describing the decisive battle was true.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But some things cannot be recorded — they were only witnessed by us.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: ...Would you mind sharing more, honored ones?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: After Aquila's defeated scream, we looked to the ground.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: The people who watched us fight — we saw the expressions on their faces.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Old and young, adults and children alike, they all shared the same expression — pure, unshakable terror.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Our victory brought no cheers or celebrations. The terrified crowd became chaotic, screaming and trampling each other...
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: When they realized that their centuries-old faith had been overturned by a cursed child of two clans...
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: They regressed into senseless beasts that devoured their own kin. No... that would be an insult to beasts. Solabis and I have never witnessed such madness, not even in the wildest corners of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: To prevent Aquila from using the sky of Amphoreus as a weapon to crush the earth, the hero Seliose chose to sacrifice herself, sealing the Titan in the process...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Legends and epics have always erased the cruelty, the bloodshed, and the cries of the commoners, while glorifying the heroes and their triumphs.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You'll witness a side of the legend that's never been told, young Hyacinthia. With a truth hidden for a millennium before you, can you still walk with the same conviction?
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: It will be a harsh truth, one that is bound to shake your beliefs. Are you ready to face it, Miss Hyacine?
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: I am ready, honored ones.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: No matter what the hidden history holds, the spirits of my ancestors will urge me to make the right choice. This mission is far more important than my personal feelings or biases.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: If what I'm facing is a distorted history, a lie that's lasted for a thousand years... I have to believe the one who created it had their reasons and struggles.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And as for those reasons, I choose to believe they came from a place of goodwill. That's how I see the world.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Since you've made your decision, keep moving forward.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: I've called forth the Rainbow Bridge. Proceed along its path to the dome where the entwined fates of humanity and the Titan must be resolved.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Careful...!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They're desperately struggling to block our path, but we've backed them into a corner.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This hurdle is trivial compared to the endless Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'll restore the bridge every time... No matter how many times the Titan obstructs us!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The miracle she never stopped dreaming of... is just one step away from becoming reality.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Honored ones... how did Lady Seliose become so powerful?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Talent, and rigorous training.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Those... sound like essential traits for every successful individual.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: She is special. Her resolve goes beyond mere stubbornness.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Continue forward along the Rainbow Bridge, heroes.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Is this the dome of the celestial mural? It's truly marvelous.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The dome still displays a vivid sun. By also covering this mural in clouds, we'll leave Aquila with no place to hide.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Exactly. Employ the tactics you've mastered to expose them, and...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: ...Hyacinthia, we will heed your wishes, channeling our strength to reveal Aquila's true form.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: My wishes...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's been a thousand years. Without our pact, Lunabis and I might have dissipated like everything else here.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Our pact requires us to await the return of the Skyfolk to their ancestral lands... to complete the mission of reclaiming the Titan's Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: We will carry out your will, Miss Hyacine, as faithfully as we kept our promise to Seliose.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: But first, we shall reveal the whole truth of history —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: — We will reveal all that befell the Skyfolk after Seliose initiated the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...As it should be.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Be careful! There are multiple threats!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Soldiers tainted by the black tide... Do they continue to defend the realm of the Sky Titan after all this time?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Perhaps they are protecting the truth slumbering here.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Aside from the descendants of the sky named in the pact, no one else is entitled to access the memories here.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: I'm increasingly intrigued by what happened next.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's deal with these fallen guards first, then...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...embark on this final lesson in history!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You have fulfilled your duty, guards... Rest now.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: God of the Sky, we are here... Your resentment and terror will soon end.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Lady Seliose... do you still have your humanity after merging with the Titan? I hope you can witness the harvest of the seeds you once sowed.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Now... only the final steps remain.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Something's off.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I can feel the memories here churning. It's as if countless emotions have lingered through the ages, refusing to fade away.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Like ghosts lingering by the River of Souls...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Are you ready, Hyacine?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes. The Flame-Chase Journey is reaching its final chapter. No matter how cruel the truth may be, nothing will sway my determination to finish this mission.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The true history buried in time must come to light. The fates of mortals shouldn't be lost beneath polished myths.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We're on the same page, Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Go to the celestial globe, Hyacinthia.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: The forgotten past will reveal itself to you, one fragment at a time. Hold fast to your resolve — you'll need it to face what lies ahead.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Smooth sailing so far. We've got one more "circuit" to fix...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's keep going and find the tablet on the other side.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Smooth sailing so far. We've got one more "circuit" to fix...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's keep going and find the tablet on the other side.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: People of Okhema, I've been blessed by the ancestors of the Sky people.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: They have agreed to bestow the thousand-year mission to me and to have me claim the Coreflame of {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Today is the year 4932 of the Light Calendar, 1062 years since the hero Seliose initiated the Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I, Hyacinthia of the Sky people, am prepared to lead the children of humanity back to the sky.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: History doesn't breathe evenly. At times, it suspends its breath for millennia as though time has frozen. At other times, it pants rapidly, as if poised to topple the world and our civilization in an instant.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Its hurried gasps have sparked a tempest, sweeping all of us along. Hyacine, as an observer, you've witnessed the return of four Coreflames...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And now it's your turn to fulfill your duty. Please, guide us into the heart of the storm as the executioner of this mission.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Seliose possessed the strength to slay gods...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Yet, she failed to sever the cycle of karma rooted deeply in humanity's hearts.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Her unconditional tolerance was met with ruthless betrayal.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Her deep love for humanity was reduced to ashes... leaving behind only endless fury.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Seliose had abandoned her humanity... Then, my Twilight Courtyard ancestors... and me... Are we truly her descendants?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The truth will soon be revealed. No matter what... I will not run away from my mission.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Grayie, will you stand by my side?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Confront history and rise to challenge the gods!
Take a moment to gather your thoughts, Hyacine.
You're right... we all need some time to prepare.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Dear Seliose,
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Are you okay? We haven't heard from you in so long...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We think we understand why you haven't replied, but we still wanted to leave these words here, just in case you see them, you know?
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We are afraid this might be the last letter we ever write to you. Oleinus has sunk into an endless night, with dreadful creatures continuing to surge from the black tide, plunging the entire city in chaos.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Right now, I'm doing everything I can to help people escape. We have been guiding them through the Century Gate, sending them to Okhema, where our sister Tribbie is waiting.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Maintaining the Century Gate takes everything I have. Lately, it feels like we are getting smaller and smaller. And to make matters worse, the lord of Oleinus is still closing in on us...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Yet we can't stop now. There are still so many people who need saving.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We have to get them to safety, far from the grasp of the black tide. It's something we can't turn away from. Any of our sisters would make the same choice without a second thought...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Dear Seliose — have you become a hero? We truly hope you've succeeded. If you have, perhaps more people will believe in the prophecy... and find the strength to stand together because of it.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We are so tired now. Maybe it's time for a little rest... and in our dreams, we will see Mama again, along with all our sisters...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: — Missing you, Trissha
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: After learning about everything she went through...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If this is the true history — was Seliose's fusion with Aquila truly meant to save humanity from ruin?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: After learning about everything she went through...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Her judgment may be true — mortals do have their flaws. But even so, human dignity must not be trampled.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She sees only the sins we've committed, but we will make her understand that it's not all we are.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She turned her back on humanity and embraced divinity... She believes we're not worth saving.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lord Solabis, Lady Lunabis —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ..."The turn of dawn and dusk, commanding the celestial globe..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Embrace the clouds, Celestial Mural."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ha... look who we've caught — an old-fashioned disciple of the ancient god!
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: The frail Titan was conquered long ago by the mighty warrior goddess. Now they're nothing more than rusted scrap, left in the forge to decay over countless years.
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: Surrender to us, relic of a bygone era! We'll reshape your clouded mind and grant you a place alongside your kin in Seliose's glory...
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: Your so-called "reshaping" is nothing more than torment, both in body and mind.
rows.speaker: Helpless Old Disciple

rows.text: No... I'd rather die than give in to hypocrites like you, hiding behind empty faith and wielding power as you please!
rows.speaker: Helpless Old Disciple

rows.text: Hahaha! Take a good look at this pathetic fool! Do you see it? What a laughable hypocrite!
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: You're one of the Sunfolk, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: When you oppressed your own under the guise of faith, leaving countless souls to suffer endlessly under the scorching sun — did you ever consider that even the fiercest sun could one day fall?
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: I... I once thought...
rows.speaker: Helpless Old Disciple

rows.text: Spare us your empty excuses, relic of the old world. "I'd rather die than give in to hypocrites like you, hiding behind empty faith and wielding power as you please!" —
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: — You've already sentenced yourself. All we're doing is following through.
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: Do it. Make it clean. A single, sharp cut across the neck.
rows.speaker: Ruthless New Believer

rows.text: No, no... NO!!!
rows.speaker: Helpless Old Disciple

rows.text: ...The creations shaped by Kephale in their image failed to inherit their compassion and acceptance.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Are you alright, Hyacine?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm fine, Lord Phainon. I... expected this.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's just... thinking about the vision Seliose held before declaring war on the Titan... this sight is deeply heartbreaking.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Let's move on.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Seliose's victory couldn't change her people. Some Skyfolk revered her as a new goddess, and began to oppress those unwilling to abandon their old beliefs...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The simple vision she carried with her before declaring war on the Titans... became an illusion.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Let's... keep going.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ..."The turn of dawn and dusk, commanding the celestial globe..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Drive out the gods, Celestial Mural."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Could that be...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But... how is that possible?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Please... help us, the forsaken Skyfolk...
rows.speaker: Dispirited Old Believer

rows.text: ...Lady Caenis, you are the strong one who follows the path of shadows.
rows.speaker: Dispirited Old Believer

rows.text: The "Cleaners"...! Did the Skyfolk conspire with them?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Word has it you hunt those with golden blood, all in your quest to cleanse the world of the filth of those cursed offspring.
rows.speaker: Dispirited Old Believer

rows.text: Deliver justice for us. The witch with golden blood struck down the proud Eye of Twilight, desecrating their divine grace. Yet, it is we, the devout denizens of the sky, who are forced to pay the price!
rows.speaker: Dispirited Old Believer

rows.text: I can smell your despair, Skyfolk... The Cleaners are on the side of mortals. Together, we'll erase that blasphemous bloodline from this world.
rows.speaker: "Caenis"

rows.text: The Daythunder Knight and her fantastic creatures are far too strong. No one can hope to defeat them in a direct fight. But we'll show you every trick, every strategy you can use to turn the tide...
rows.speaker: "Caenis"

rows.text: In their desperation, those ancient disciples were willing to do anything — even ally themselves with the Cleaners.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But I'm guessing their plan failed, didn't it?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Those assassins were vicious, but not foolish. They never actually dared to attack Seliose.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: They weren't driven by any genuine desire to help the oppressed. Their true targets were the innocent Chrysos Heirs hidden among the Skyfolk.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: These schemes only came to light long after the damage was done.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Before the Flame-Chase Journey began, the Chrysos Heirs waged war against each other over who was a "legitimate" heir of the prophecy. Even Tribbie's many selves were pulled into the chaos.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: At the time, golden blood was seen as a curse. Honestly? It's easy to see why.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But Seliose... where was she in all of this? What thoughts weighed on her mind as she watched everything unfold?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You'll know very soon, Miss Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: The oppressed old believers didn't hesitate to team up with the Cleaners, but those assassins had never thought of directly provoking the mighty Seliose. Instead, they trained their daggers on the innocent Chrysos Heirs hidden in the Skyfolk's midst...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Seliose... how exactly would she have felt to witness all this transpire?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You'll know very soon, Miss Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: [Trailblazer], where are you going?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Use the Time Priest's instrument to rewind the platform. We have to get out of here!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Phainon... Aglaea is...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I know.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I... know...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It worked! Let's go!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: We all have something worth living for —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And we all want to see Okhema's second dawn —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This path isn't as safe as it looks... Stay sharp and watch your step!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The door's frame is coming down!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: [Trailblazer] — give us a hand!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's getting worse!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Stay close to [Trailblazer]... Don't fall behind!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's getting even more unstable...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Make sure you get the timing right!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Finally... can we catch our breath now?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This platform feels like a cage... Let's hope nothing goes wrong.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Wait... what was that sound?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Everyone — once the platform stops, we make a break for the exit...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't hesitate, not even for a second!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is the Sky Castrum collapsing because of Aquila's fall?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A Miracle Orb! Let's use it to open our escape route!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Dear Seliose,
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Are you okay? We haven't heard from you in so long...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We think we understand why you haven't replied, but we still wanted to leave these words here, just in case you see them, you know?
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We are afraid this might be the last letter we ever write to you. Oleinus has sunk into an endless night, with dreadful creatures continuing to surge from the black tide, plunging the entire city in chaos.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Right now, I'm doing everything I can to help people escape. We have been guiding them through the Century Gate, sending them to Okhema, where our sister Tribbie is waiting.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Maintaining the Century Gate takes everything I have. Lately, it feels like we are getting smaller and smaller. And to make matters worse, the lord of Oleinus is still closing in on us...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Yet we can't stop now. There are still so many people who need saving.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We have to get them to safety, far from the grasp of the black tide. It's something we can't turn away from. Any of our sisters would make the same choice without a second thought...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: Dear Seliose — have you become a hero? We truly hope you've succeeded. If you have, perhaps more people will believe in the prophecy... and find the strength to stand together because of it.
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: We are so tired now. Maybe it's time for a little rest... and in our dreams, we will see Mama again, along with all our sisters...
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: — Missing you, Trissha
rows.speaker: Message Slate

rows.text: "Lift the curtain of memory—"
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The mural's control over the weather was severed long ago. Whatever happens here shouldn't affect the world below... or so I hope.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Aquila is the eleventh Coreflame of the Flame-Chase Journey. The final Coreflame of Kephale is enshrined in the council hall at Dawncloud.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We're so close to achieving the miracle. Humanity will finally take control of its fate...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We must not yield to her scorn.
Her judgment may be true — mortals do have their flaws. But even so, human dignity must not be trampled.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Humans aren't as contemptible as she thinks.
She sees only the sins we've committed, but we will make her understand that it's not all we are.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Perhaps there's a trace of compassion left in her.
She turned her back on humanity and embraced divinity... She believes we're not worth saving.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lord Solabis, Lady Lunabis —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Is that...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Great Seliose, I beg you — spare this humble life!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Skyfolk

rows.text: I've never harmed anyone... The punishment you deliver out of rage is far too harsh for someone innocent like me!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Skyfolk

rows.text: The time has come, mortal —
rows.speaker: Memory Solabis

rows.text: — it's time to face your destiny.
rows.speaker: Memory Lunabis

rows.text: Wait! Please, let me speak with Her Highness, the warrior goddess!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Skyfolk

rows.text: Look! Can you see it? Golden blood is spilling from my wounds! I am a Chrysos Heir too... chosen by the prophecy, just like Lady Seliose!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: She isn't lying...
rows.speaker: Memory Lunabis

rows.text: Seliose, what will you do with one of your own?
rows.speaker: Memory Lunabis

rows.text: A Chrysos Heir...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: You are no different from the rest.
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: You were once one of the Sunborn... Did you ever rise to defend the weak when your kin oppressed others under the guise of the Titan's favor?
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: I... did not.
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: You abandoned your old faith and made me your new god after Aquila's fall.
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: Did you offer your help when your comrades turned their blades on the faithful who refused to convert?
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: I... did not.
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: When the Prophecy of Genesis reached all beings, calling the Chrysos Heirs to become heroes of this fractured world...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: ...did you overcome your inner weakness and heed its urgent call?
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: I... failed to do so.
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Look, Chrysos Heir... you are no different from the rest...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: My judgment is just — only burning gold can purify your sins...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: ...Wait, Lady Seliose — please, grant me a moment to explain my cowardice!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Your divinity indeed casts our mediocrity in a harsh and unflattering light. Humanity has walked this earth for many ages, enduring life's struggles and witnessing its shameful imperfections...
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Yet, despite everything, we built great city-states and thriving civilizations! Even when trapped in the mud of malice, we continued to struggle and push forward...
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Because beyond our flaws, the virtue that we all share is tenacity!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Even if it means risking everything I have and everything I have yet to gain... I must kneel before you, begging for a chance at life. I need to prove that mortals are capable of redemption!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: To admit your weakness in such a righteous manner... it seems you have completely abandoned your dignity.
rows.speaker: Memory Solabis

rows.text: You say you're willing to risk everything you've yet to gain...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: Tell me... what kind of miraculous bet is that?
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: It's simple, Lady Seliose...
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Should you grant me a chance at life, I will ensure that your epic is passed down through generations, sung by my descendants until the end times buries all civilizations and legends.
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Should the Prophecy of Deliverance we've heard hold even the slightest chance of becoming reality...
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Then my descendants will return here one day to prove to you that even the flawed and imperfect mortals you disdain can bear the weight of the world!
rows.speaker: Unnamed Chrysos Heir

rows.text: Ha... interesting.
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: Release her, Solabis, Lunabis.
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: From now on, she and her descendants will carry both the sky's blessing and the curse of their history. No matter how long it takes, I will wait for the one who is destined to arrive...
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: When that time comes, I'll take pleasure in mocking these mortal children on how their progenitress sold their unborn lives.
rows.speaker: Seliose, Theos Synthetos

rows.text: The golden thread... is trembling...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: This device is too old. It might not work...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We're out of time. We have to retrieve it... [Trailblazer], quickly!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "—and stir up ripples of past reverie!"
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: From here on, Phainon, you shall embark on a journey with no return.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Light fades only to await the sun's rise.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: One day, you will step forward — not out of fear...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...but to return the dawn to this world.
rows.speaker: Aglaea & Phainon

rows.text: ...It's right in front of us.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The platform has reset above us... We need to find a way up!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This way, behind! That door leads outside —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There's got to be a path!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Lightning and thunder...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The Celestial Mural is showing the end of the world.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...as long as we can make it out of here!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The platform is just ahead!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hyacine, where are those winged beasts?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm trying to locate them, but the storm clouds on the mural are blocking my senses!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We could use their wings to escape if they were still here!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We'll have to rely on our feet for now. Keep moving...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...We're not safe yet!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We're almost there. The end is just ahead. All we need is a rainbow bridge...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: A West Wind Compass... leave it to me!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Focus, Hyacinthia! Stay focused...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Why does this have to happen now...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We're out of time. The fortress runs on Aquila's divine energy — if I can channel the Coreflame...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It worked! The Coreflame responded. Everyone, let's get out of here!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Everyone, hold on tight!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Isn't that sound... How's that possible...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No time for speculation...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: — Run!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Children of humanity... you have overturned the judgment I once cast in disillusionment.
rows.speaker: Seliose's Voice

rows.text: Beginning with a lie disguised as a heroic legend, passed down for millennia, a grand epic of creation has been written...
rows.speaker: Seliose's Voice

rows.text: ...You are worthy of a new dawn.
rows.speaker: Seliose's Voice

rows.text: The truth of the legend... is finally clear.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hyacinthia...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Am I... the descendant of that nameless Chrysos Heir?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Our lineage wasn't from the hero...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...but from a nameless Chrysos Heir who begged for mercy before her.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: My whole clan's fragile mortal life... was simply spared on Seliose's whim...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Tell me... did you wait for a thousand years at the Eye of Twilight... Just to witness that Chrysos Heir's child coming back to receive punishment?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Time alters everything, child.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Once upon a time, we had not yet learned to read the complexities of human nature, and Seliose's perspective was our only window into understanding humanity.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Her words were everything to us: Our guide, comfort, command, and admonition.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: It wasn't until she fell silent that we learned to perceive humanity through our senses.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: During our resistance against the black tide... we watched over the earth, observing the progress of the Flame-Chase Journey. We saw heroes embarking on a mission of deliverance from which they could not return.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: The unity and hope Seliose couldn't see... we've witnessed in her place.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: We've changed, young Hyacinthia. Our watch isn't about proving humanity's weaknesses anymore...
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: ...It's about waiting for the return of the light.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Lady Seliose! I want to tell you this! Doesn't matter if you can hear me or not!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I want you to know that I am glad to be born as the child of a nameless and ordinary mortal!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Only then can I prove to you that tenacious hope, buried in the deepest part of the human soul, has not been lost to time! It's just waiting to heal and grow, and then it will shine once more.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Even the most cowardly individual harbors a seed within. Perhaps in your era, the light on the horizon was too dim for it to sprout...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But do you see it now? A thousand years later, the path you forged is now walked by many brilliant heroes.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: They love the people of this world unreservedly, willing to sacrifice themselves to shine a light upon the children of humanity.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The light they leave behind will inspire the seeds within people to sprout, grow, and thrive, nurturing them every step of the way.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Until the barren land is reborn as a thriving forest, growing endlessly, and one day... reaching for the sky once again.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That "twilight," still capable of being healed and protected in the end times... is the reason we choose to bear the weight of humanity's flaws.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: History has proven once again: The Flame-Chase Journey itself is a miracle —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It began with a whitewashed lie, but it laid down a path of deliverance for humanity over thousands of years.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Seliose, we have honored the promise made by that nameless Chrysos Heir and returned here. We also bring you the answer to your question —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mortals are capable of change... and humanity is worth saving!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Our people, forging through the trials of the end times, deserve a second chance — we are worthy of a new dawn!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hyacine —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Yes! Solabis, Lunabis —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We are here, Hyacinthia.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: We are here, Miss Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Give me your strength. I've made my decision, and we stand resolved.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: For all that mortals have built, I will follow the guidance of the prophecy and claim the Coreflame of the {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Eye of Twilight{RUBY_E#} —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The children of humanity have returned from the earth, and we... will challenge the skies once again!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Aglaea...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Are you... still protecting us?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, Aquila's Coreflame —
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is it... all over now?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Seliose condemned humanity, casting them into the pool of gold. In the end, she too was...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Take that Coreflame with you, Hyacine. Our mission isn't over.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hmm... Coreflame of the sky, come with me...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's a strange feeling. It's so warm and... powerful.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Holding it in my hand, it feels like the winds of this world might turn for me... Summoning thunder or snow is just a thought away.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I understand how you feel, but right now...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...this platform is on the brink of collapse. Who knows how much longer it can hold. We need to find a way to leave.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, over there —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: A Time Priest's instrument. Does it still have any divine power left?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No idea, but we have to take a gamble. If the prayer can rewind the shattered platform, then we might ride it back to the entrance...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...and also retrieve Aglaea's amulet.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We can't delay any longer. Everyone, move quickly!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Who came up with this uniform? It's got more pockets than it needs. Nobody wears this style anymore, do they?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Back in the days when I was doing honest work for the Goldweaver, I saw my fair share of these...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh, what do we have here?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...A paper note? Talk about old school...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh, right... once the seamstress's powers diminished, the World Wound Web slowed drastically, from five threads to just two...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Looks like I was too quick to judge — physical note-passing still outpaces the reduced threads.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: This dagger's got a nice look to it. Let's see it...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Wow, it's crafted from Kremnoan steel — these people are well-equipped.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: By any standard, you all are quite capable. Had you not strayed, you could have been guarding Okhema, securing a stable income.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Such a pity... In your next life, remember to choose a safer path, and stay away from dangerous jobs like this.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Let me take a look at what's hidden under that mask —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Hmm... your face looks innocent enough. Who would've guessed that such a pretty face would hide a heart full of darkness?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Appearances can be deceiving. It's a fool's game to judge someone's character just by their looks.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: It's amazing what the seamstress can do with her divine authority. She sees right through people with that golden thread of hers, beyond whatever facade they put up.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: As for using divine powers... I'm no slouch myself!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Well said. You've got a good memory.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's late... Anything else you'd like to add?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Anything else...?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Even in your imagination... I'm not one to show my vulnerable side.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Ha... no worries. I've long understood how difficult it is for you to open up completely.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Thank you for bringing me here, Aglaea... You saved me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heh... maybe what I wanted to save wasn't you, child...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...but this crumbling world.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Goodbye, Phainon.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Goodbye, Aglaea.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hmph... Did you forget me?
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: Ha, forget you? Like I'd ever.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The leader of the "Cleaners" fell into an eternal slumber, her death so peaceful that it fomented resentment.
Perhaps, at the distant end of the west wind, there will be a just law that can convict the sins infesting this elder's soul.
We aren't parting ways forever. You're just off to guard the gates at Castrum Kremnos. Let's not make this a tearful farewell.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heh... you know just how to make a person uncomfortable.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: I have a feeling we'll meet again in this lifetime. Let's have another showdown then, "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: That's very confident of you. I've changed since then. Have you seen this sword? It's a masterpiece, freshly forged by Chartonus.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ha... A bold statement for a mere mortal who hasn't yet claimed the power of a Titan.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: See you around, Phainon of Aedes Elysiae.
rows.speaker: Mydei

rows.text: No... it's too late. This sky has been completely swallowed by the black tide...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Tribbie would have made sure to warn us if there were any mention of it.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: All we can do is hope she can protect as many lives as possible...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mm... We should not waste our time on a pitiful madwoman.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...No need to argue. We're just wasting our time on a pitiful madwoman.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng is right. My sword yearns to end your pathetic life...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No... There's no need for such trouble.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No... We don't need her help.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No... There's no need to go through that effort.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Professor Anaxa taught me more than just what was in the textbooks.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Calm down... and think carefully.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Calm down... and think carefully.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: [Trailblazer], calm down!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "I'll do my job, so you..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But if she wasn't successful...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Her actions may have been deplorable, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She may not have sought sympathy from others, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As a "Cleaner," she was willing to use forbidden arts to absorb a millennium of identities and memories for an objective that hasn't changed in that time... I suppose this is also a form of extreme but twisted resilience?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I agree...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: No... Now is not the time.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I've been waiting for a chance to face them head-on...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The lack of reason... can't be overcome.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the end... direct confrontation was inevitable.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If words won't work... then we can only express our resolve with our blades.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We shoulder the fates and futures of too many people...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's a date, Mydeimos.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...What a poignant, yet splendid journey.
And it's still not over yet... is it?
Yes, Cyrene.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I was right. In the end, you did become the Deliverer in this story.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A lot has changed while you were away. I've met so many people and tried so many things. I've found new resolve... and I've let go of some attachments.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm not the same person I used to be.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hee...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Please don't worry, [Trailblazer]. Lord Phainon has already entrusted Elder Lygus to fix your transport.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: But to me —
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You've never changed at all, Phainon.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Days later, at Dawncloud...
Ah, Dawncloud... This place holds so many different kinds of memories.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I remember you could see the "Goldweaver" sign from here, all the way down the mountain.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But my eyes aren't what they used to be a thousand years ago...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Cifera, you...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Seamstress! Tell me!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Does Okhema have any treasures so rare that not even your... I mean, our shop, has seen?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Of course, it has. I heard there's a "Gem of All Worlds" hidden somewhere in Dawncloud. Apparently it's a piece that fell out of the Dawn Device.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's truly a priceless treasure, being a part of Kephale's divine body. Even I, the Goldweaver, cannot witness its glamour.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: "Gem of All Worlds"...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Nice! Got it! Well, please keep looking after the shop while I—
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Let me guess, Cifera.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You're probably already plotting to sneak into Dawncloud to steal that gem, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Erm.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: And your next move is probably trying to sell it to the highest bidder, then distribute that money to the poor and the refugees in the holy city.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Look, seamstress. Are you sure you aren't peeking into my head with your golden threads?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Trinnon...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You might be skilled at covering up lies, but your compassion is all over your face, plain as day.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Don't lie to yourself. Do you honestly think this is the right thing to do, Cifera?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...What else am I supposed to do? That's the only thing I can do with my power!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You keep talking about how I have the potential to become a good person, or even what people call a "hero"...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But I don't know what I need to do to get there... I can't weave golden dresses like you, I can't sing as well as Miss Hysilens, and I definitely don't know as much as big sis Tribbie...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The only things I'm good at are the underhanded street smarts that no one even respects!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But... but I still want to be worthy of you. I want to prove that you've made the right choice. Even thieves can dream, right...?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I know, Cifera... I know.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You are justified in your anger. Destiny is never fair, and your path is doomed to be even worse than everyone else's. You are fated to walk in the dark and bear the world's misunderstanding in this journey.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But you have to believe that everyone in this world is unique in their own way.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I am convinced that you're the only one who can bear the authority of Trickery, even if you have to contend with the legendary three hundred master thieves of Dolos.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: A–Aglaea...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I just want everyone to believe that the world is beautiful and that everyone is simple and kind... If only I could get everyone to believe that...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Would that lie become reality if enough people believed in it? ...Even though it's a lie?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Lies will always be lies, Cifera.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But sometimes... they can be more noble than the truth.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...Are you really planning to just stand there forever? Honestly, sneaking around doesn't suit you, Deliverer.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ahaha... I never thought I could slip past your sharp ears, Miss Cipher. I just didn't think it'd be right to interrupt when you're obviously lost in thoughts.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hmph. Still as charming with your words as ever, boy. Your speech at the public baths wasn't half bad, I'll admit. It managed to touch my heart just a smidge.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Thank you. I had a feeling back then that you were in the audience. Intuition certainly is a thing of wonder.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Oh? And you didn't call me out on the spot? You waited all this time to tell me?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Well... I thought you'd need some time to yourself... after she passed away.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hm. None of your business.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Enough small talk. Tell me, what kind of trouble did you run into that you need me, the super-old-timer, to step in?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Understood, Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: We've only met a couple of times, but you've always gone straight to business. I respect that about you, "old-timer," so I'll cut to the chase.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You're probably aware that Aglaea has earned the support of the entire city for the Chrysos Heirs. Everyone believes that she died at the hands of Council members who are against the Flame-Chase, and the citizens' fury has been dragging these schemers out of the shadows one by one.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But they didn't get everybody. To this day, we still haven't found Elder Caenis — the leader of the "Cleaners."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah. I see. You're afraid she'll do something wild now that she's pushed into a corner, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Yes. I believe that Kephale's Coreflame, forever enshrined above the council theater, would be the opposition's final trump card against the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We're setting out to campaign against {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#} in a few days. With the Chrysos Heirs gone, it'll be their best chance to strike...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You think those desperate dogs will try to snatch the Coreflame while you're gone —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: — So you want me to give them a nice long walk while you're away, right?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You sure saw right through me, Miss Cipher. I know exactly what you can do. God-like speed, perfect disguises, untraceable movements... And that most enigmatic authority of "Trickery."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I have only one request. Please, use whatever tricks you need to protect Kephale's Coreflame, even if you have to deceive the rest of the Chrysos Heirs as well.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Uh-huh...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Hey, Deliverer. Do you honestly think that there's no way I'll turn you down?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The prophecy has always remained shrouded in ambiguity even if the twelfth Coreflame is returned, no one knows how the Era Nova will manifest... let alone if the miracle will extend its favor to two visitors from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Do you even have any Plan Bs if I decide to nope out on this?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: As the demigod of Trickery, there are no other trump cards in the world that can out-rank you — I'm sure you know the answer to your own question, Miss Cipher.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What confidence. You talk as if you have everything in the palm of your hand... Hmph, so you did learn a thing or two from her. I'll give you that.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Then let me tell you something you don't know. The Flame Reaver — they've been watching Okhema closely.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You mean...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Bet you didn't expect that, huh? I've been tracking them all this time, and this is my conclusion.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: That lunatic may have lost their mind, but they're no fool. Why do you think they haven't made a move on Okhema yet?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Professor Anaxa once analyzed this. He thought... It was probably because Kephale's Coreflame was protected by the Council of Elders' secret arts?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ha! Secret arts my foot. I could break those mechanisms with a flick of my finger.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Allow me to let you in on the actual secret. They probably held off from attacking Okhema because the seamstress's defense network was way tougher than you thought.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Now that she's gone... and you're heading out to battle the Eye of Twilight... with the city's defenses in shambles... tsk tsk tsk.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...What a dangerous situation we find ourselves in.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But since you're the one who brought it up, I'm guessing that you already have a solution in mind.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Just look how ridiculously calm you are right now...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But you guessed it right. Consider this a two-for-one deal. I'll keep that lunatic entertained on top of protecting Kephale's Coreflame — You owe a big favor after this.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You have my deepest gratitude. That Flame Reaver's power is truly unfathomable. Please be careful.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't forget, Deliverer. There's a fundamental truth in this world. "Cifera will always get the last laugh." No need to worry for a demigod. I'll do my job, so you —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Meanwhile, in the Grove of Epiphany...
I'm back...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I've been trying to stay away from here since the black tide destroyed the Grove... And through that, stay away from the memories that might make me sad.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But the wind keeps pulling me back... Maybe that's the Twilight Courtyard's duty, after all.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I know, Little Ica. I know... I too miss the days when we all studied together.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But we have an even more important mission this time round. Lord Phainon has already set the date to campaign against {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}. Being a descendant of the Sky people, I...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You're right. At least I can still afford to get lost in thought once in a while.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: O ancestors, please wait for just a bit longer. The time I spent in the Grove... deserves some reminiscence.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This was where Professor Anaxa gave us "the lesson."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I can still see that day in my mind...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...And that was your last lesson in the Grove.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Now, each of you will head off on your own path. How much the Grove's teachings can help you in the real world depends on how well you can put knowledge into practice.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: However, heed this warning — If you ever do anything disgraceful out there, don't ever claim you were the student of Anaxagoras, one of the Seven Sages-
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...Professor Anaxa, there are still other classes scheduled on the calendar! Are you sure you didn't —
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: —Firstly, call me Professor Anaxagoras.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Secondly, to clarify — The "last lesson" means "the last lesson I will teach you." I will be entering seclusion from today onwards to research ancient alchemy, and all my teaching activities will be put on hold.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Ah, I see. So you're saying the lessons taught by all the other teachers aren't good enough to be considered lessons?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: All you do every day is wag that sharp tongue of yours — That's a credit deduction, Phainon of Aedes Elysiae!
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Hee...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Sniff... sniff...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I have nothing left to say. Next-
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...Please wait, Professor!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: According to the Grove's protocols for a cohort's final class, the lecturer should take some time in that lesson to "discuss the students' post-graduation aspirations with them and guide them toward a solid path."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Surely you can't skip such a crucial step, Professor?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Tsk...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: The teaching assistant Miss Hyacine is truly Professor Anaxa's nemesis.
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: ...Ahem, fine. Since Hyacinthia insists on this... Let's go through the process.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Since some of you are so eager to speak, why don't we start with you, Phainon of Aedes Elysiae? What is your post-graduation aspiration?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Me?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Well... it's not exactly an aspiration, but the only thing I want to do is to protect the people I care about...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...I see. So you want to be a "hero." How boring. Next!
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Uh, I didn't say...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heehee...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: Castorice! You've been giggling for quite some time. How about you go next?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...Eh? Why did it suddenly stop?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: *cough* ...Just a tiny hiccup. No worries. Let's try again.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Perhaps my answer is a bit vague and meaningless, Professor Anaxagoras, but...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: I hope the world can be freed from the agony of "death," so that every living being may find calming peace...
rows.speaker: Castorice

rows.text: How naive. So naive that it makes me want to weep for your fairy tale.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: See? This is why I don't want to follow those outdated protocols. All I get are boring answers.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Since you suggested this whole process, why don't you wrap this up, Hyacinthia? Share your "aspiration" with everyone, and let's see if yours stands out.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: So it's finally my turn...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Good thing I came prepared, hehe! My aspiration is nothing less than completing the final "blank page" at the end of the heroes' epic.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ..."Blank page"?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: An interesting description. Do explain, assistant.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I've read all of Amphoreus' heroic epics while studying at the Grove, and a common thread came to my attention.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Almost every epic ends with a description of the hero's achievements, but few mention how the everyday people of that time lived. No one recorded the struggles and suffering the commoners endured.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: So you're saying that, instead of legendary heroes, you're more focused on commoners living on the peripheries of historical records?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Perhaps I'm influenced by my background. My ancestor, Seliose the Daythunder Knight, raised her spear against the Sky and ushered in the Flame-Chasing era that continues to this day.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Her story is told to every child descended from the Skyfolk. We have no doubts about Seliose's greatness, yet... her towering figure overshadowed every record from that entire era.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: What about the Daythunder Knight's family, allies, and friends? What about the survivors and those who died in the great battles? Whenever I think about their stories by the campfire, I realize the details of those legends have been long lost... and only Seliose's name remains.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Her brilliance had become as blinding as Aquila's, lording over everything on the ground.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That's why... I'm glad that my era does not lack heroes.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: All my ancestors had was a sad past, but I have a future I want to protect. Instead of becoming a hero and ushering in a golden deluge to baptize the world anew, I want to stay in the back line and save all the ordinary humans from drowning in the rising waves.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I wish not to return to the sky, but to walk among the masses on earth. I believe it's the only way for the saga of creation...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...to include a footnote for the everyday people in its blank page.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ah... I'm getting embarrassed from remembering how I said all that.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But my beliefs have never changed. Now I really have a chance to stay behind the heroes' frontline and realize my dream.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Hyacine?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dannie! What are you doing here?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I didn't expect to see you again in the Grove. Phainon mentioned you were gearing up for the campaign against Aquila. Are you here to...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You guessed it. To reach Aquila's realm in the sky, descendants of the Sky people must perform a bloodline ceremony, summon the spirits of our ancestors, and get their blessings.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That's the only way for creatures on earth to forge the rainbow bridge to the sky, and the soul of the first ancestor I want to see is here in the Grove.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The rainbow bridge is essential to retrieve the Coreflame of {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}, but undertaking such a vital ceremony alone is far too risky.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't worry. I have Little Ica with me. You'll protect me, won't you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Good Ica~ Well, what brings you here, Dannie?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'm collecting as many myths and research about the Titans as I can. Everything about Amphoreus is a valuable addition to our data bank when I get back to the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ah... right. If all goes as planned, you and Grayie will be able to go home after this mission, won't you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Yes, assuming we can actually break the curse about 'worlds beyond the sky'... I have a feeling it's not going to be smooth sailing.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Oh? Could it be that you, too, have some kind of hidden powers to make prophecies now?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That's not it, but... I'm starting to question how real everything is after a conversation with a member of the Council of Elders.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Doot... Doot?
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: Nope. I didn't understand that either, Little Ica.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Don't worry about it. There's a lot that I still don't understand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Since we've already met up, why don't you come with me, Dannie?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I was thinking the same thing. The Grove is fraught with danger right now, and an extra pair of hands translates to extra security.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's the dependable "Express Guard" for you. So, shall we get going?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The Chroma Coffer is vibrating...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: There must be memories of an ancestor nearby.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But, uh... Boss Lady, there's a chance Aglaea wasn't trying to trick you...
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: What's this...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is the divine object of the Sky people, the Chroma Coffer.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Our ancestors dictated that when a descendant of the Skyfolk is ready to challenge {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#} again... they must first awaken the spirits of their ancestors with the Chroma Coffer and receive their benediction.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Only after this can the chosen Skyfolk re-ascend to the heavens.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Is it to prevent those who are not qualified from pointlessly losing their lives?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Very prudent, wouldn't you say?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Sniff... sniff...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The soul of an ancestor slumbers here... Now, I will awaken them.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Right.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Doot.
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: I am Hyacinthia from the Twilight Courtyard, a descendant of the Sky who has inherited the duty of Flame-Chase.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The time has come to fulfill our clan's destiny. I will join the heroes of the prophecy to return to the sky and retrieve the Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ancestor, please bestow upon me your generous blessing...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Listen carefully to Hyacine talk with the ancestor.
Anyway... What's with all this water? It's damp, cold, and miserable here. I hate it...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Who... has awakened me?
rows.speaker: Ancestral Ghost

rows.text: It's I, Hyacinthia, a descendant of the Sky people. I apologize for interrupting your slumber.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You are Lord Crispus, aren't you? I've read your story in our family tree. You were a righteous judge who vindicated many who were wrongfully accused.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ah... I never imagined someone in this era would still remember my name.
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: So, our bloodline and duty have continued to this distant age...
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: Indeed it has. I have awakened you in the hope of receiving your blessing.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: For the Flame-Chase Journey is nearing its perfect conclusion, and retrieving the Coreflame of {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#} is the final challenge the heroes will face.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Perfect conclusion...?
rows.speaker: Crispus
