rows.text: Hyacinthia, you look very young... and you do not have the bearings of a warrior who can contend with a Titan.
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: How can you convince me that this blessing will not turn into a curse, leading a child like you to your demise?
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: A thousand years ago, Seliose who conquered the skies left behind legends and a will, entrusting the mission to return the Sky Titan's Coreflame to her descendants — to people like you and me.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Though I'm not a warrior, I will not turn away from the mission that has flowed through our blood for a thousand years.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And I am not fighting alone... I have the strongest and most tenacious companions in the world.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Amphoreus is in an era brimming with heroes! The burden of retrieving {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}'s Coreflame no longer rests solely on the shoulders of the chosen Skyfolk.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Mmm...
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: I now wield the power of healing. I aim to mend the fissures in the sky and heal the wounds of the people.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I desire to define the mission of the Skyfolk in my own terms... to conclude the vigil that has spanned millennia.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I sense resilience in your words... not an outward resilience, but something deeper within.
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: Receive my blessings, young Hyacinthia. May you gain wings to return to the sky via the bridge of rainbows.
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: Thank you for your trust, Lord Crispus. We won't let you down...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Well done, Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Heh... Thank you.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: My ancestors were all pretty strong-willed people. It won't be easy convincing them. I've run through these upcoming conversations in my head more times than I can count.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Looks like your efforts paid off.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: After a discussion, she obtained the first sky blessing from Magistrate Crispus.
The Vortex of Genesis... unbelievable. Dannie is full of surprises.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But... This does feel way more disorienting than the ritual basin...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Wait, is Lady Tribbie here too? And who is that next to her...?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ah. I think I know who that is.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Do you have to go already, Ciphy?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's been ages since you were last in Okhema. You could've taken some time to rest, and we could've caught up...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: That's alright, big sister Tribbie! I've gotten used to life on the road. Staying in this bustling city actually feels off.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Besides, your prized student... gave me an incredibly tough mission to handle.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (Hmph...)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Sniff... sniff...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Besides, Snowy's not the kind to ask for help lightly. Since he came to you, it means you're the best person for the job.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: You really spoil him, big sis Tribbie. Guess I'm past the age for someone to look after me...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ciphy —
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...Just kidding, I get it. That Deliverer boy does have a certain charisma about him. It reminds me of Aglaea in her prime.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Anyway, I'm about to head out. Oh, big sis Tribbie, before I go — Got a little gift for you.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Wow, didn't expect you to be so thoughtful... What's in it?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Heh... That's a part of the game too. If you want to see the full picture of what's inside, you'll have to wait until nightfall.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: A gift with a mysterious twist? Seriously?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...Hmm? Looks like we have company.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Lady Tribbie, and... this graceful lady must be Miss Cipher.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'm Hyacinthia from the Twilight Courtyard. Everyone calls me Hyacine — pleased to meet you!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Tsk, bright and cheery as a lamp...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Ahem. Well, hello there, pink child. I'm Cifera from the long-fallen city-state of Dolos. As for the rest... it's all in the history books, so I don't need to repeat it here.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: So you're from the Twilight Courtyard? Does that mean...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Yes, I'm a descendant of the Sky people, the Chrysos Heir about to take over the authority of Sky.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Well, that's... unexpected. I figured Seliose's descendant would be... I don't know. Taller? Stronger?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Don't judge a book by its cover, Ciphy. Cinny is a master of her craft. She's the most skilled and dependable physician in all of Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Agy...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: So, you... really don't have to take the medicine anymore?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: No need, teacher. Medicine can only steady my flesh, but it cannot stop the decay of my soul.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I've already borrowed too much time from this world... And now, the time is up.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Now... is the best time for my exit.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: *sob*... *sniffle*...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Please don't cry on my account, teacher...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I have... a final selfish request. Can you lend me an ear?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: *sniffle* Agy...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Go ahead... *sob* We will... definitely fulfill it for you.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I wish for my death to be quiet and gentle. I hope that my lifeless body... will not be exposed to the eyes of the public.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Teacher, I have faced too many changes in my lifetime. But in the pursuit of one thing alone, I have remained unchanged for a thousand years...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...It's "beauty," isn't it?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Huh...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: That's right, teacher. "Beauty."
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Agy, do you think Snowy is... ready?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: A thousand years ago, when I took up the Coreflame of Mnestia... do you think I was ready then, teacher?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Born into this era, we had no choice but to grow amidst the raging waves, not set sail after everything was prepared.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Phainon — he will understand. He will grasp the duty I've left to him... He is mature enough now, no longer blinded by anger or hatred.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: She really was taken by the Cleaners...
I can't imagine, how she could've been taken down by a handful of assassins...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Something about this feels like a scheme...
I hope so...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If this is all part of a larger plan, Tribbie must know something. She just couldn't say it in the message.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Why didn't they go after us?
I also don't understand... This doesn't add up.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She really was assassinated...
No, that doesn't make sense...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The ones who appeared in the Grove, and those who confronted Dan Heng in the Abyss, didn't immediately resort to violence. They were just watching and trying to intimidate.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How are the two of them holding up?
Not well. After all, we witnessed Lady Aglaea's... last moments.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You witnessed Aglaea's...
Yes... we witnessed her final moments.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I tried to treat her immediately, but even the sky's blessings...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Phainon —
...Chartonus?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Chartonus has arrived.
Be quiet, and listen carefully.
...Oh! Alright.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: There's something special about a man of letters.
Indeed!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: If it were me up there, I could do it too.
...You think highly of yourself, don't you?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The Flame-Chase Journey is nearing its end, with only one Titan left for the Chrysos Heirs to conquer: {RUBY_B#Sky Titan}Aquila{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't worry, Lady Cipher. I may not be as strong and warlike as Lady Seliose from a thousand years ago, but I'm confident I can carry out the mission of the Skyfolk.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Ahaha, all this talk about missions... you're making it sound way too serious.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You've gotta look out for yourself, girl! Don't push yourself too hard. I'd hate to see that cute face all scratched up by Aquila's claws...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ciphy, cracking jokes? Looks like you haven't forgotten what Agy said all those years ago.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...Anyway, I've got a mission to handle, so I'll get going.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Good luck, Miss Hyacine. And if things get tough, just let that Deliverer take the lead!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Cipher uses the Coin of Whimsy's ability and teleports away from the Vortex...
Miss Cipher is in such a hurry.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Don't worry. She's always been like that... It's good to have her back in Okhema lending a hand.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Well, enough about her for now. You're here because of your mission, aren't you, Cinny?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: It's the perfect opportunity for me to go and tuck Ciphy's gift away somewhere safe. The Vortex of Genesis is all yours.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Speak with the ancestor.
Skip this narration.
You're back. How did it go?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It went great. Your spirit water art was a huge help, Dannie.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Do you mind sharing what your ancestor's spirit said to you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hyacine recounts her conversation with General Ektra to Dan Heng...
What's wrong, Dannie?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Nothing. It sounds like everything went smoothly. It's just... I'm a bit concerned about the prophecy you mentioned.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "At the end of the rainbow bridge, the Skyfolk will mend dusk and dawn."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I can somehow sense a hint of... sadness in those brief words.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You've always been a bit of a sensitive soul, haven't you, Dannie? Lady Trinnon deciphers countless prophecies every day, and this one's just another among many. Don't worry too much about it.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'll stay here to lead the guards and maintain order. Find out what happened — but don't take too long. With Aglaea gone, someone has to take her place and lead Okhema.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: Also, Miss Hyacine was the one who declared Aglaea dead. You might want to speak with her.
rows.speaker: Krateros

rows.text: ...I hope so.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Come on, Dannie. Don't look so gloomy. We're gonna have to take a long trip for the final visit to the ancestors.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Where are we going?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Our final stop is Lord Mydei's home — Castrum Kremnos.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We're here. This is it.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Castrum Kremnos...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lord Mydei has been fighting the black tide here alone day after day... I'm worried about him.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: He sent a message earlier, carried by thunder, warning us to watch out for the Flame Reaver's actions.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That means he hasn't been consumed by the black tide's madness yet.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We're here to complete an important mission... We shouldn't interfere with his battlefield. Don't you agree, Dannie?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I agree.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There — that sleeping spirit... is my grandmother.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Your... grandmother?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yes. My grandmother Jacyntha was a warrior. She represented the Twilight Courtyard in the Kremnos Festival.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: She fought her way through every challenge and reached the final stage of the Kremnos Festival. She was just one step away from securing a peace treaty for the Skyfolk, but... was ultimately defeated by the champion warrior of that time.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I've never looked too deeply into the details of such ritualistic violence. The scrolls simply described it as "a glorious duel."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But behind the glorious duel... was a tragic end. Not long after the festival, my grandmother's injuries worsened, and she passed away far from home. This Prophecy Tablet was left here by the Kremnoans to honor her final wish.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Her death marked the final collapse of the Twilight Courtyard, already fragile under the shadow of war.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And the Kremnoan warrior she fought against...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...was Lord Krateros.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Yet you still saved his life, even though he took your family.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Seeing him lying there, gravely wounded, bleeding out... I can't put what I felt at that moment into words.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But when I heard Lord Krateros took that fatal blow to protect Lady Trianne... All those tangled feelings faded away.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: To quote Lord Phainon, Krateros must have done that "to become a better man."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It takes true courage to forgive. You're every bit as strong as your ancestors, Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Heh... You're getting better at this, Dannie.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: In her final diary entry, my grandmother wrote that when the moment of destiny comes, a descendant of the Sky people would deliver the message of their departure to her spirit.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I wonder what she'd think... When the one awaking her turns out to be her beloved granddaughter.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Listen carefully to Hyacine talk with her grandmother.
Is this... the world of the living?
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Wait... You... could you be...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Grandmother, it's me, your Hyacinthia.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hyacinthia, my little hummingbird! Why... how... Why is it you who awakened me???
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: I have never imagined this... I thought I would feel happy for all my ancestors when this day came, but now...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: I can't even experience the joy of seeing you again!
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Do you remember that... you and Father took me to my very first Sky Rite when I was eight?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Back then, you wanted me to pick one accessory out of four: The sun crown representing nobility, the storm bracelet symbolizing strength, the ice ring embodying wisdom, and the radiant pendant signifying kindness...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Grandmother, do you remember the one I chose?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You spoke an innocent little prayer, infusing a faint thread of light to that modest pendant...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Yes, and I remember how surprised you were. In all those centuries, no other child of the Sky people had ever made the same choice I did.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hyacinthia... There was a time when I thought you were a timid child.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: You never had much interest in swords or battle, and had no relation to that fiery determination and strength in our blood.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Yet I've told myself — that's not a bad thing. If my hummingbird could live her life in kindness and optimism, then it'd be a good thing.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: I never thought the burden of retrieving the Coreflame of Aquila would fall to you...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Don't worry about me, Grandmother. I believe what makes someone a Skyfolk isn't just outstanding strength, but the capacity to shape the world.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: When the world cried out for a hero to challenge the gods a thousand years ago, Seliose stepped forward and began the Flame-Chasing era...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...And now, as the Flame-Chase Journey nears its end, this broken world is crying out for something else — healing.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Isn't it poetic? A saga that spans a thousand years began with Sky, and will also end with Sky...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Heh... you're still as optimistic as ever, just like when you were a kid.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: If your mind is set, Hyacinthia, then carry your resolve through to the very end.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Return to the sky with my blessing, and watch over this world on the threshold of salvation.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Grandmother... thank you, but I have one last request.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Speak, Hyacinthia. We should still have some time.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Before you go... could you tell me the tale of the sky hero once more, just like you used to?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hehe...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Then, listen closely, my dearest hummingbird. After all, this will be the last time...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: After a discussion, Hyacine obtained the third sky blessing from her grandmother, Jacyntha.
At the moment of parting, Grandmother told Hyacine one last time the legend of the hero of the sky — Seliose the Daythunder Knight...
For millennia, the Titans waged relentless wars, leaving the world scarred and ravaged.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: A century of the Chrysos War plunged the nations into chaos and decay.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Until a spear, fueled by mortal rage...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Pierced through the smoke and flames that buried the prophecy of deliverance.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Aquila, the celestial shaper, the hundred-eyed divine bird crowned with the blazing sun and wielding thunder...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Though struck blind in ninety-nine eyes by Nikador, they kept one eye, glaring at the children of twilight who received divine blessing yet turned their weapons against the gods.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The Chrysos Heir of the Sky, Seliose the Daythunder Knight, ascended the forbidden lands of the Eye of Twilight at dusk, clad in wings.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: To her left was the lion-headed Solabis, the Sunlit Wings, whose roars breathed divine flames and scorched the world.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: To her right was the horse-bodied Lunabis, the Moonlit Plume, whose graceful steps trampled the stars in the heavens.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The one warrior and her two beasts challenged the ruler of the sky, determined to seize the divine Coreflame through plunder.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The Titan's every roar summoned lightning bolts, and their every movement stirred cyclones.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The wounded Titan's blood... poured down like boiling rain upon the world and converged into scalding torrents.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: In the final moments of the battle, the Sunlit Wings set the Titan's wings aflame, while the Moonlit Plume sealed the divine body...
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The battered hero of the sky, with her wings broken and her body covered in wounds, struggled to lift her spear... and pierced the last monstrous eye.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The Titan's divine body crashed to the ground, and with it, the sky tore apart like fabric, about to fall with its god.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: The fear and pleas of mortals urged the hero of the sky to rise again.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Seliose the Daythunder Knight, the first of the Chrysos Heirs to slay a god in this world, charged into the crumbling body of Aquila with her two fearless winged companions.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: She merged with the Titan, holding up the sky once more, only to leave behind a powerful message for the world —
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: "My descendants will be blessed and cross the rainbow bridge back to the sky... At the end of the Prophecy of Genesis, they will reclaim the Coreflame from my hands."
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Thousands of years ago, in the sleeping quarters of Kephale's priests...
Hehe...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Uhh...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Seriously, where did they hide that thing...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Trash, just trash... What is this? Never mind. I'll take it anyway...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Ah, I finally found it!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: It must be this! The Gem of All Worlds that the Chaplain secretly stashed away, said to be a fragment peeled from the Dawn Device...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Sniff... sniff...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Heh, I can already catch the sweet scent of treasure seeping from this little box. So much for the Chaplain's devotion to faith — it turns out he's just been padding his secret stash...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I've been lurking in the Priestly Court for over half a year just for this little trinket! Day after day, listening to those stiff priest apprentices drone on with their prayers. I thought I was going to lose my mind...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Good thing persistence pays off, heh...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Atti... Atticus... is that you?
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: (Atticus? That name rings a bell... Oh, he's the apprentice the Chaplain favors most, the one everyone expects to be the next Chaplain...?)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (Not saying anything would feel awkward... maybe I can hold it together with {RUBY_B#Trickery Titan}Zagreus{RUBY_E#}'s ability for now?)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (Now... I am Atticus.)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Atti...cus? Why aren't you... responding...?
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Old... ahem, Chaplain, it's me. I'm here to assist you with your medicine.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah... thank you. Without your care, I would've long been claimed by {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#} and carried to the River of Souls...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Oh... no need to thank me, master. It's my duty to care for you while you recover.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (This old man is way sicker than I thought... Looks like the priests are deliberately hiding how bad it really is.)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Atticus... I can feel my life slipping away, fading faster with every moment. I don't know when eternal sleep will claim me...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: There's one last thing I must tell you...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: (One last thing? Wait... is he hiding more treasures? Holy "Coin of Whimsy"!? Today might just be my lucky day!)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (Ahem, calm down, Cifera... Just breathe.)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Stay strong, Chaplain. Keep your spirits up and don't lose hope.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: If there's anything important you need to say... I'm all ears.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah... it's so disgraceful that it fills me with shame. Yet, I must speak... for it concerns the fate of our holy city below my feet.
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: (What? The fate of the city's people? Is it that serious? I must find out more...)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The omniscient sky father, {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, before they fell silent... I heard their last words at Dawncloud...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: They announced: The prophecy has arrived, my mission has concluded, and I shall return to silence...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: (Oh, the Prophecy of Genesis. The Titan turned to stone... Heard it a thousand times. Old news. What else you got?)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The eternal night is looming, but over the next three hundred years, the Dawn Device will safeguard the holy city, poised for the children of humanity with golden blood to create miracles...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: (Mmhmm, the Dawn Device, the miracle of Genesis, the usual clichés...)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (Wait, did he just say... "the next three hundred years"?)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I... have concealed the deadline the sky father set for everyone...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: I lacked the courage to carve the countdown to the city's new dawn into the hearts of its people...
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Atticus, you... are a hundred times more courageous than I am. Can you accomplish... what I could not?
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Will you share this harsh truth... with all the citizens of Okhema?
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Atticus...?
rows.speaker: Dying Chaplain

rows.text: Rest easy, master. I will shoulder this heavy burden for you... I'll address the fallout of your indecision.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Is that right, Seamstress? "Everyone in this world is unique in their own way..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: My moment to be a hero... has finally arrived.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...And that was my stint as a priest at Dawncloud. Sure, the story's been slightly embellished, but every word of it is true.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: These are secrets that must remain undisclosed. I've never shared them with anyone, not even Bartholos.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You should feel incredibly honored to be the first to hear this.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Unfortunately, you can't clap or comment right now.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But that's beside the point! Getting to spill the secret I've been holding in for a thousand years feels amazing right now.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Honestly, I'm surprised at your persistence...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I wanted to stand here beside you, to condemn the sinners, to discuss retribution, and to see justice brought down upon them...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I merely staged a slip-up for you to witness the switch of the Coreflame... Who'd have thought you'd follow me all the way to the Nethershore?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: That Deliverer kid was spot-on. You rejects, shunned by the Okhemans, have no choice but to keep moving down this dark path...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: One, two, three, four... wait...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: What's going on? Your leader Caenis isn't here? Could she be plotting something else?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah, such a hassle... Well, for everyone's safety, I might as well check if you're carrying anything suspicious.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Hmm... no trace of Caenis. Is she hiding too well, or has she given up?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Well, I've done everything I could. Now it's in the hands of the Deliverer and his crew...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Huh!? What was that —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The noise came from above, could it be...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ha... it looks like they pulled it off.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The Deliverer's impressive, no doubt, but some of the credit should go to that Gray Mystery from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I've crossed paths with them before. They're a little quirky, but their power? Absolutely terrifying.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: With the Coreflame of Aquila taken...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...the Flame-Chase Journey is down to its final threat.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah... they're already here. Barely gave me a moment to catch my breath.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Alright then... Guess it's my turn to see what you've got!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh! You made it? I've been waiting for you!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Black-clad swordmaster, the Flame Reaver, whatever your name is —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Look at you, sniffing around like a starving hyena... chasing the scent of the Coreflames!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: What's wrong? Cat got your tongue? Or maybe you're just too dense to understand plain speech?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Throne of Worlds{RUBY_E#}... Coreflame...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: Must... take back...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: You sad little thing, I've got you all figured out!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Let me guess — you've been eyeing these last two Coreflames all along, huh?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: No wings, no allies... what a pity. Even with Aquila's Coreflame sitting idly in the sky, you're helpless to reach it.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: All you can do is sit and wait for the Chrysos Heirs to bring it down, then swoop in like a brute to snatch it for yourself, isn't that so?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Hah! Struck a nerve, have I? I've seen you lingering on a cliff more than once, staring hopelessly at the sky. Pathetic.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But hey, I'm feeling generous today — I've got a surprise just for you.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...That's right! I have Kephale's Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But if you think you can snatch it from my claws...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...you'll have to catch me!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Fun fact! Dolos cats aren't just quick on their feet...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: They've got the stamina to match!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ow! How... how did you get ahead of me!?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Don't swing that thing — easy there!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You're after Kephale's Coreflame, aren't you? Fine, take it! The Deliverer made me steal it! It's no use to me anyway!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Wh—Why!? I thought Okhema was safe!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I fear no corner of this world is safe right now!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Their objective must be the Coreflame — we have to beat them to the punch!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Look, uh... since we've got the same taste in fashion — all black and sleek — how about you spare this poor cat's life?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: That's the spirit! You get the Coreflame, and I get to keep breathing — everyone wins!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Haha! You really are a brainless mutt, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Woof, woof! Come on. Come on, you're not gonna let a little setback like a lost bone stop you, are you?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (...Well, look at that. They actually caught up with me. No one's ever managed that before...)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: It's been a while since I've had a chase this good. Don't quit on me now — I'm just getting into the groove!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: A wise cat doesn't look back. Don't run in the wrong direction!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The leader of the "Cleaners" fell into an eternal slumber, her death so peaceful that it fomented resentment.
Perhaps, at the distant end of the west wind, there will be a just law that can convict the sins infesting this elder's soul.
Can Hyacine fix the sky...
No... it's too late. This sky has been completely swallowed by the black tide...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Was this not predicted in the prophecy?
Tribbie would have made sure to warn us if there were any mention of it.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: All we can do is hope she can protect as many lives as possible...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She... looks like she's got a screw loose.
Mm... We should not waste our time on a pitiful madwoman.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Time to avenge Aglaea.
You are turning everything upside down!
...No need to argue. We're just wasting our time on a pitiful madwoman.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng is right. My sword yearns to end your pathetic life...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How're we gonna find a core member now?
No... There's no need for such trouble.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We'll just have to force Caenis to help us.
No... We don't need her help.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: That Lygus, should we seek him out?
No... There's no need to go through that effort.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Professor Anaxa taught me more than just what was in the textbooks.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Uh oh, looks like it's end of the line for us...
Calm down... and think carefully.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Where should we go to look for the Coreflame...?
Calm down... and think carefully.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Madness! I will strike her down for you!!!
[Trailblazer], calm down!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: "I'll do my job, so you..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You trust her that much?
But if she wasn't successful...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What if something happened to her...
Of course, partner!
You have to trust us too!
Another apocalypse? Been there, done that!
A fate well deserved.
Perhaps, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: She was a formidable foe to the end.
Her actions may have been deplorable, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I will not shed a single tear for her.
She may not have sought sympathy from others, but...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As a "Cleaner," she was willing to use forbidden arts to absorb a millennium of identities and memories for an objective that hasn't changed in that time... I suppose this is also a form of extreme but twisted resilience?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Now's not the time for a fight...
I agree...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You gonna test the results of your training?
No... Now is not the time.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I've been waiting for a chance to face them head-on...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Just give up on talking sense to them...
The lack of reason... can't be overcome.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's time to show off the fruits of your training, Phainon.
In the end... direct confrontation was inevitable.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: They keep repeating themself like that...
If words won't work... then we can only express our resolve with our blades.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We shoulder the fates and futures of too many people...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Cre... ation...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: Must...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: You sure stumble over your words, but you've got some speed on you!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I'm going to speed up. Don't get left behind!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ha, just in time to take a break.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Don't tell me that they might already be waiting for me upstairs...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: What? Still not here? Well, that's disappointing.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh well, I guess I'll just...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...wait around a little longer for you!
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: Styxia, you're stunning... Oh? Look who it is — the Flame Reaver!
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: First time — wait, no, not the first time meeting you. I'm the great hero of Okhema, the Deliverer of Amphoreus!
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: They say I'm destined to return Kephale's Coreflame and carry the weight of a new world on my shoulders...
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: But hey, fairness is my thing — fairness, fairness, and *Dolos profanity* fairness! You want the Coreflame? Come and get it! But only if you beat me fair and square!
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: Ugh, boring... I was hoping you'd at least humor me for a little while.
rows.speaker: "Ciphainon"

rows.text: Stupid mutt. Fooled by the same trick twice...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...Bye-bye, "Flame Reaver"!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Sigh... Not as fun as I'd hoped. I guess a brainless brute isn't much fun when it comes to mind games.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (I... seriously can't shake them off, huh... This is borderline impossible)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (They're not going to back off anytime soon... Well then...)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: (...Guess I'll just have to lead it somewhere higher.)
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: The plan can't fall apart... lead that mutt up high!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Deliverer! You'd better thank me —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Every leisurely second you enjoy... was fought for by yours truly!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: A thousand years ago, at Dawncloud...
To all citizens of Okhema — today, I bring you two pieces of news: one sorrowful, one joyous.
First, let us offer our blessings to the departed. Our beloved Chaplain Phoros has returned to the embrace of Sky Father Kephale. May he rest in peace...
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: But citizens, do not grieve his passing! In his final moments, Chaplain Phoros found peace. While he still had his wits, he heard the final words of the sky father...
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: And that brings me to the joyous news I share with you today! Before the great Worldbearing Titan fell silent, they spoke one final message to my revered mentor. And now, I shall share those words with every soul in Amphoreus!
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: They said: "The prophecy has arrived. My mission is complete, and now I shall fall into eternal silence..."
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: "The eternal night is looming, the Dawn Device will safeguard the holy city, poised for the children of humanity to create miracles... forever!"
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: Until... forever?
rows.speaker: Grateful Citizen

rows.text: Sky father's love transcends time itself, stretching across endless eons!
rows.speaker: Excited Citizen

rows.text: Citizens, friends! As the newly appointed Chaplain, I propose we host a grand hundred-day celebration at Dawncloud, a feast in gratitude for the sky father's gift!
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: Our mission is to transform the sky father's words into unshakable faith. For a hundred dawns, through song and dance, every child of humanity within Amphoreus will come to believe —
rows.speaker: "Atticus?"

rows.text: — The light of the Dawn Device never fades... Kephale's protection has no end!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "You shall walk with greed, and die over petty change..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ha, the prophecy's "petty change"...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Was quite literal, after all...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Atticus... He's a good kid...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I stole your identity... I... owe you an apology...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: But I owe more than just an apology... There's also you, Agy...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Back then, I... I had to leave Okhema...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You see, you were so good at reading hearts... if I had stayed by your side...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: My fragile lies... would have been exposed sooner or later.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Your weave shop... I wish... I could chance upon it again, just once...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: To be scolded by you and Tribbie...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Ah... I'm sorry...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: In the end... I...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: I overestimated myself...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "But... at least there's one thing... I did accomplish..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Kephale's Coreflame is not here... It's safe... It's safe now..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Even if I'm nothing more than a thief... I..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "...At least I did something for the Flame Chase..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Agy... can you hear me?"
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Say something... anything..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: "Please..."
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: You are the unsung hero of Amphoreus, Cifera. You saved us all.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You betrayed the world...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...and in exchange, you earned humanity a thousand more years of life.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Dusk... has descended as ordained...
rows.speaker: "Flame Reaver"

rows.text: Hyacine...? What happened?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Coreflame in my hand... it's trembling. It's sending me a warning...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Lord Phainon, in Amphoreus's mythology, isn't the Dawn Device said to be a gift from Aquila to Kephale?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Why bring this up now? Let's focus on getting back down there...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Lord Phainon!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Yes. Nearly every mythologist agrees "Aquila gifted the Dawn Device to Kephale."
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Everyone, calm down... listen to me.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Dusk... has descended as ordained...
rows.speaker: "Flame Reaver"

rows.text: The Coreflame in my hand trembles violently, its warmth slipping away like sand through my fingers.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It burns through immense energy just to leave me with one message: The Dawn Device... is extinguished.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: This isn't something to joke about...
Who's responsible for this?
It's not a joke, Grayie...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I... don't know.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: If the Coreflame's message is true, Okhema has lost the Dawn Device's protection...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Darkness will consume the holy city in an instant... and the aftermath will be devastating.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon... I feel something too...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: You sense it as well?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: While Hyacine was speaking... countless streams of memories rose beneath our feet, spiraling into the sky...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: There are so many, so heavy... Even through the fortress walls, I can still hear them clearly...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Birds, nymphs, people... their memories tangled together, their cries echoing as one.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Could this be because of the Titan's fall? But that doesn't make any sense...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: There's no time to dwell on the cause! Without the light of the Dawn Device, the holy city will be consumed by darkness, and countless lives will be cast adrift...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Everyone, you must return and fulfill the mission of Chrysos Heirs. As for me...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Dannie, you're still carrying Phagousa's spirit water, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: What...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Meanwhile, in the Eye of Twilight...
That was just a precaution... It's not the time...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No, the time has come. Open the path to the Vortex for me. There's still one last thing I can do for the people down there...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Return the Coreflame of Aquila and inherit their divine authority...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'll remain in the sky and cast my protection over the people.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You're... staying?
There must be another way!
We'll go with you. It's the fastest way.
Yes. I'm afraid this is a goodbye, Grayie...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Don't waste time thinking about alternatives. This... this will resolve everything.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That might not be possible. "The entrance serves as the exit"... It's a one-way passage. You need to return to the holy city and deliver Kephale's Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And an entrance created this way... only has space for one person, doesn't it?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Yeah.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dannie, I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "...Under the raucous steps of their frenzied dance, the roar of celebration hides the world's heartbeat."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Spirit water, reveal the way."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "At the end of the rainbow bridge, the Skyfolk will mend dusk and dawn."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lady Tribios's prophecy... It seems it didn't fail after all.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It still feels unreal, even after seeing it a second time...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You'd move in perfect harmony with the rivers and seas of this world.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But we can't stay. [Trailblazer] and I... we have people waiting for us, a home calling us back.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Astral Express, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: March 7th, the one you always mention... I'd like to meet her someday.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'm sure the two of you would get along wonderfully.
I can almost see the three of you traveling together, laughing and sharing moments.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: And you, Hyacine? Do you not feel sadness?
Of course, I do. A sharp, aching sadness... I feel every bit of it.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Why hide it? No one here would mock you for showing true vulnerability.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As a healer from the Twilight Courtyard, Dan Heng, it's my duty to stay composed in front of those suffering from illness. A sorrowful expression would only add to their burden.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The world I love is the one suffering now. How could I face it with a frown?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Farewell, Hyacinthia.
Goodbye, everyone...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...I understand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please, become the heroes this world needs. And as for the final "blank page" of this epic, the lives and stories of ordinary mortals...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I'll guard them, until the very end.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: A few days ago, in Okhema's "Twilight Courtyard"...
Miss Hyacine... are you really leaving?
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Yes! Lord Phainon has already set the date for our departure. As a descendant of the Sky hero, I must prepare myself and carry this responsibility.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: What about this new Twilight Courtyard?
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Believe in yourself, Clementine! You're an exceptional healer, more than capable of handling things on your own.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The patients trust you, and you've earned that trust... That's what matters, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Miss Clementine's medical skills are amazing! We believe you'll make the Twilight Courtyard proud!
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Thank you, Lady Tribbie! I... I'll do my best.
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: I just... don't have the same confidence and certainty as Miss Hyacine. No matter how severe the illness or injury, she always faces it with a smile...
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Honestly... I'm not confident about everything, Clementine.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I've just learned how to hide my unease well — it's a skill I consider essential.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's hard to imagine anything making Miss Hyacine feel uncertain.
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Well... shall I give you an example? Since Lady Tribbie happens to be here too...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Wait, we're part of this?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Look at the Flame-Chase Journey. Since Lady Aglaea took over the leadership of Okhema, every Chrysos Heir entrusted with a Coreflame — aside from Professor Anaxa — was personally chosen by her.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I was the outlier... The hero Seliose entrusted her bloodline with the legacy of the "Sky." Lady Aglaea's thoughts on my potential remained a mystery, even up till the day she left.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: So I've always carried a lingering doubt about my ability to fulfill this role.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Heh...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Lady Tribbie... Why are you laughing?
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: The answer Cinny wants is simple! Just try looking at it from another perspective.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Imagine this: Knowing Agy's personality, if she believed you weren't worthy...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Don't you think she would have considered other plans?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Heh... now that I think about it, I feel much better.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I may not have Lady Aglaea's keen judgment, but I would never question your resolve, Miss Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Clementine

rows.text: Thank you, Clementine!
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I had a sudden thought, Lady Tribbie. Before I depart, can you teach me the words for returning the Coreflame?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I've always been at the Grove helping with lectures and never had the chance to come to Okhema... The phrases everyone has memorized still feel unfamiliar to me.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I don't want to embarrass myself in front of everyone when it's my turn to return the Coreflame.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: It's easy! We can teach you right now. Let's go — we will say a line, and you repeat after us.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "O majesty of the Twelve Titans."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "O majesty of the Twelve Titans..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "Pillars of the world."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "Pillars of the world..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "We seek your divinity."
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: "We seek your divinity..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: "...To mend the rifts of the world—"
rows.speaker: Hyacine & Trinnon

rows.text: "Fill our bodies with blood of gold..."
rows.speaker: Hyacine & Trinnon

rows.text: "Till we wither in willing service to the prophecy."
rows.speaker: Hyacine & Trinnon

rows.text: Surrender the Coreflame, Chrysos Heir.
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Doot... doot, doot-doot!
rows.speaker: Little Ica

rows.text: Cinny, are they...
rows.speaker: Trinnon

rows.text: Lord Solabis, Lady Lunabis...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The mission of the Skyfolk has been completed... Your watch can finally come to an end.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: We thank you, Miss Hyacine...
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: Even though we were the source of that false legend, you still brought us freedom.
rows.speaker: Solabis

rows.text: Please don't say that. Without your wings, we would have struggled to progress in the Eye of Twilight.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Okhema is on the brink, and I must quickly embrace the role of demigod to protect everyone with the power of the Sky.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Honored ones, please tell me... what trials lie ahead for me to complete?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I think you've already done everything you were meant to, Miss Hyacine.
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: What do you think... Seliose?
rows.speaker: Lunabis

rows.text: The Skyfolk...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: Lady Seliose?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I see... after all these long years, your will has merged with the Titan's divinity.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I... deeply regret...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: I... beg for forgiveness...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: The darkness in the human heart... clouded my judgment...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: I failed to recognize... the resilience buried deep within...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: ...Of those present that day, I don't know how many were innocent, how many truly deserved their fate.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: That's why I cannot forgive you on their behalf, Lady Seliose...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The spirits of my ancestors resonated with me. You exiled our people, and they may never forgive you for that, but...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...At least there is one thing we can agree on. The truth that no one can distort —
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: The courage it took to defy the gods was undeniable, unwavering. That same spirit now lives on in those who walk the Flame-Chase Journey, growing stronger with every step.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: You were the spark that set this era in motion, Seliose...
rows.speaker: Crispus

rows.text: An age where heroes rise and epic stories are told far and wide...
rows.speaker: General Ektra

rows.text: An age where a flame of hope was preserved for the world.
rows.speaker: Jacyntha

rows.text: Hehe...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: Perhaps... this is what I longed for...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: Now, I can finally rest in peace...
rows.speaker: Voice of the Sky

rows.text: Even in that darkest moment, Lady Seliose, you still held compassion for mortals, didn't you?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Even with the Titan's power... you didn't punish the world by letting the Sky fall. I imagine you were waiting for someone to bring redemption.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Trust me with the power of the Sky. I am merely a healer. I could never match your strength even with that power...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Thankfully... the world no longer needs a demigod who can summon thunder and storms. What I must do is merge with the Sky, and...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: ...Cast down a gentle rainbow, protecting as many lives as I can.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Professor Anaxa... do you remember that lesson?
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: In the end, I followed the path of my ancestors, returning to the Sky... I didn't return to the earth, to walk with the people.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: But even so...
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: I still achieved my dream.
rows.speaker: Hyacine

rows.text: Hyacinthia... thank you.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The sky is burning.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Okhema's Dawn has come to an end...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Why is this happening...?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: This darkness... Its power probably surpasses that of the Titans.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Even if Hyacine takes the divine authority of the sky, she probably won't be able to banish this darkness...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The black tide... its power probably surpasses even that of the Titans.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is this... the end for Okhema...?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Don't give up. We're the ones leading this journey... so we can't afford to lose our way.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The unexpected is always part of our journey. We'll stay with Okhema until the end, no matter what.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Over there — do you see it? The broken structures look like they've turned transparent...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've never seen anything like this before... Could the black tide be the cause? There are too many things we don't understand... and we don't have time to figure out.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We can't delay any longer... Let's head down. Hopefully, Kephale's Coreflame is still safe...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I'm confident that Miss Cipher will do everything in her power to fulfill her duty.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The transport platform's route is blocked by rubble...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: [Trailblazer]! Help buy us some time!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The rubble blocking the path has been cleared.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Good job. Now we can get off the mountain.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: A black tide creature... at Dawncloud!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Oh no, the people in the city!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We must find out where they breached the city from...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Tribbie! Please hold on till we get back!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: More enemies. It doesn't look great down there...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Anyone who dares stand in our way... will get a taste of Dawnmaker's edge.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Over there! Kephale's Coreflame is being kept in the center of the Council.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We must retrieve it and bring it back to the Vortex of Genesis.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You mean...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Right. Worst case scenario... We need to be prepared to return Kephale's Coreflame at any moment.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If the end is indeed upon us, we no longer have time to investigate the truth behind the miracle — we'll have to trust that Professor Anaxa's hypothesis is the only option.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Apologies, Aglaea... I promised you that I would leave the choice of Era Nova to the people of Amphoreus...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: But I'm afraid there's no room for doubts now.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hyacine... Did she make it?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Her will to heal the world is so strong...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We'll definitely sense it if she's succeeded.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Is that...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...A "Cleaner"!?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: O Sky Father Kephale, please forgive these ignorant and lowly children of humanity...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: They are so utterly naive that they think of the golden-blooded heretics as Deliverers...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: This bloodred sky, and the raging flames and demons throughout the land, will purge their foolishness...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Caenis...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah... Lord "Deliverer"?
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Why don't you join me in praying to the benevolent Kephale...?
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Cast your eyes on this ravaged land... All of this, sins committed by you blasphemous heretics...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: You are turning everything upside down!
We have more important matters to attend to... We shouldn't waste our time on a pitiful madwoman.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But to a cornered dog like you, the most deserving punishment is to personally witness the Chrysos Heirs fulfill their mission.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Only then... will you truly know how meaningless and foolish your past transgressions were.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Heh... Fulfill your mission?
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Kephale's Coreflame is long lost to the winds. How will you... fulfill the prophecy?
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Lost to the winds...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: She's gone completely mad... to the point where she's just spewing nonsense.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: For the longest time, Kephale's Coreflame has been worshiped here... Only core members of the Council of Elders know how to activate the Coreflame Casket.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The sins of the Chrysos Heirs... have finally transformed into divine punishment...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: None of us... no one can escape...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: Leave her, [Trailblazer]... Focus on the objective.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Where are you going, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come back. We need your powers to open the Coreflame Casket.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...We did it!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Take the Coreflame and let's hurry down the mountain!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Hah... Hahah...
rows.speaker: Caenis

rows.text: It's done. Let's go, we...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Phainon.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A fate well deserved.
...How should I mess with them this time? Let me come up with a plan.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: She was a formidable foe to the end.
I will not shed a single tear for her.
Who came up with this uniform? It's got more pockets than it needs. Nobody wears this style anymore, do they?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Back in the days when I was doing honest work for the Goldweaver, I saw my fair share of these...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh, what do we have here?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: ...A paper note? Talk about old school...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Oh, right... once the seamstress's powers diminished, the World Wound Web slowed drastically, from five threads to just two...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Looks like I was too quick to judge — physical note-passing still outpaces the reduced threads.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: This dagger's got a nice look to it. Let's see it...
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Wow, it's crafted from Kremnoan steel — these people are well-equipped.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: By any standard, you all are quite capable. Had you not strayed, you could have been guarding Okhema, securing a stable income.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Such a pity... In your next life, remember to choose a safer path, and stay away from dangerous jobs like this.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Let me take a look at what's hidden under that mask —
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Hmm... your face looks innocent enough. Who would've guessed that such a pretty face would hide a heart full of darkness?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Appearances can be deceiving. It's a fool's game to judge someone's character just by their looks.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: It's amazing what the seamstress can do with her divine authority. She sees right through people with that golden thread of hers, beyond whatever facade they put up.
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: As for using divine powers... I'm no slouch myself!
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Let's go... It's time to leave this place.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Everyone, can we run faster?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I've got a bad feeling!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: E—Everyone!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Look, behind us...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The Flame Reaver...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In the end... they still showed up.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Now's not the time for a fight...
You gonna test the results of your training?
But not now... If we take the fight here, then lose... the consequences would be irreversible.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Come on... We have to get out of here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Keep running... and never turn back!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Janus's Hidden Passage — we have to use it to cross Theosphere Lake!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They will catch up to us sooner or later...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Keep running. Don't stop!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: It's him! Lord Phainon!
rows.speaker: Startled Citizen

rows.text: Wh... What in the world happened!?
rows.speaker: Terrified Citizen

rows.text: Retreat to the temple! Protect your family and friends!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The chaos will soon cease... I promise you!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: How did they...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Clones, illusions... nothing but cheap tricks to help you hide in the shadows.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The Sky... has returned to its rightful place...
rows.speaker: "Flame Reaver"

rows.text: This world... must... be reset...
rows.speaker: "Flame Reaver"

rows.text: What... What are they talking about!?
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The end you seek... is also the Miracle of Genesis?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: If so, you should be standing alongside the Chrysos Heirs! Why do you hinder us, "Flame Reaver"?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Must... reset...
rows.speaker: "Flame Reaver"

rows.text: We... will not fall here!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We trust you, Lord Phainon! No matter what choice you make...
rows.speaker: Panicked Citizen

rows.text: We'll be waiting for your return!
rows.speaker: Panicked Citizen

rows.text: The people in the market... must also be suffering.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I hope Hyacine can protect them in time...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Chartonus!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Quick, let's go check on him!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Chartonus! Hang in there!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah... Returned, Phainon...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Burning... the holy city is. To resist... I did all I could.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: You shouldn't be on the frontline at your age, Grand Craftsman... Where are the citizens? What's the situation at Marmoreal Market?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Organizing their escape... the holy city guards are. But... where to flee to, no one knows...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Descended from the sky, the rainbow barrier did. Protected the people... but alleviated the fear, it could not.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: I fear this is Amphoreus's end, Chartonus. There is only one way to save our home...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Ah... Finally come true, the sky father's prophecy...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Go... miracle, create it. Deliverer... you shall become.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: One more thing... there is.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Waiting at the Vortex of Genesis... Lady Trinnon is.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Kephale's Coreflame is safe... she said.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Black tide creatures... Prepare for battle!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Urgent... the situation is. Leave them to me... the monsters.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Died... I should have. Kept me here... the power of the rainbow light did.
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: But if destined... inescapable, death is...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Why not... leave behind some glory?
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: You've been forging nothing but glory your entire life, old friend — for others, and for yourself. May you never see the slightest glimpse of war in the new world.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Farewell, Grand Craftsman.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let us depart... to the Chrysos Heirs' baths!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: For battle... these hands were not meant...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: But, if to protect the holy city's future, they are needed...
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: To the final moment... I will fight!
rows.speaker: Chartonus

rows.text: Chartonus said that Trinnon had news of the Coreflame...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As expected... Miss Cipher did not fail her mission!
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Chartonus has made up his mind...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We have to keep moving forward, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Chrysos Heirs' baths... Not a soul in here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Those translucent structures are here too...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: These buildings...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: I can feel it... Their memories are dissipating.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Buildings... have memories too?
Will this spread to other places?
Yes... the textures of memories are preserved within all things in Amphoreus. Even a single brick or tile holds countless traces of the past.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Core... flame...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: I'm not sure... In any case, none of this feels right.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The textures of memories are preserved within all things in Amphoreus... Even a single brick or tile holds countless traces of the past.
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: There are no citizens trapped here, nor any signs of black tide creatures... We have no reason to linger here.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Let's head downstairs... The bath chamber isn't far away.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The baths' waters are conveying sorrow and despair in ways I can barely comprehend...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm getting a vague sense of foreboding here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Th—They caught up to us!
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Don't tell me that Mydei...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: Tsk...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Can we defeat them head-on?
You guys go ahead. I'll shore up the rear!
Phainon, take [Trailblazer] to the Vortex of Genesis. I will stay here and hold them off.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng, you...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Don't hesitate, Phainon. You still shoulder the mission of the Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We don't know if the Flame Reaver has any clones up ahead... [Trailblazer], stay close to Phainon and keep him safe.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Amphoreans often speak of "destiny"... The destiny of the Trailblaze is to bind the life and death of every world to our own existence.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Such a hasty farewell... I won't allow it.
Everyone in the Crew is still waiting for our return!
I'll stay together with you...
This isn't farewell. Don't worry. I'll do everything in my power to survive.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I don't intend to say goodbye forever to anyone. Don't worry. I'll do everything in my power to survive.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Someone has to buy time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's not goodbye forever, [Trailblazer]. Don't worry. I'll do everything in my power to survive.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Time... running out...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: Everything... will be reset.
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: You better keep your word, Dan Heng...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You cannot die here!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wherever there's flowing water, I can harness its power to purge the filth.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This power... Unfamiliar...
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: Who... are you...?
rows.speaker: Flame Reaver

rows.text: Even if I were just a passing traveler, I would not hesitate to lay down my life and protect the unfamiliar world beneath my feet... This is the destined course that a Trailblazer cannot escape.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I am a Nameless, and what I'm going to do...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...is defend all the hopes that are on the verge of fading away.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Follow me.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: We have to get to the Vortex of Genesis quickly!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Lord Phainon!
rows.speaker: Determined Holy City Guard

rows.text: Finally, you're all back!
rows.speaker: Loyal Holy City Guard

rows.text: Even in such desperate times, you still managed to keep your promise to me... I am grateful beyond words.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Phainon, what is this...
rows.speaker: Mem

rows.text: The Flame Reaver is wreaking havoc in the city, and they still have many clones. Zeph, please get someone to inform Krateros, and have him lead the most elite guards to defend the city's passages...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Until I complete the Coreflame ritual... please do everything you can to rescue the citizens in the city.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Mnemosyne... Several citizens are trapped in the Garden of Life, and are temporarily seeking refuge under Hyacine's barrier. Can you dispatch some people to evacuate them?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Though... I also don't know where to shelter them.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Leave this to us, Lord Phainon. Just focus on your own mission.
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: All right. As for [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng, I'll also leave them to you.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: What in the world is going on...
Are you hiding something from me, Phainon?
My apologies, [Trailblazer]. I acted on my own this time.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I prepared for the worst before the fight against Aquila. Even if there came a day when Okhema was taken by the black tide...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: As long as we defeated Aquila, lifting the sky's curse... you and Dan Heng would at least have a chance to get home safely.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: You... already made plans?
The final lap is always the hardest...
The progress bar is already at 95%, and you're leaving me on a cliffhanger?
Yes. I knew you'd object, so I didn't inform you beforehand. My apologies.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Sorry, I know you must dislike leaving things unfinished, which is why I didn't inform you beforehand.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I know this is hard to accept... but even if it means being resented for the rest of my life, I still have to be responsible for you.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Friend, you and Dan Heng taught me the spirit of Trailblazing. The best decision I ever made in my life was when I followed my intuition and chose to trust you.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Dan Heng told me many stories about the adventures of the Nameless. Two of them left a deep impression on me: "Belobog" and "Penacony"...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: The first story taught me that the fate of a world should be in the hands of its people. And... even if the Nameless are willing to risk everything for an unfamiliar world, in the end you still have to embark on a new journey and go to the next world that needs saving.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Because that's your mission... the Path you follow.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: In the second story, Dan Heng told me about the few Nameless who sacrificed their lives for the "prison world." I know very well that the two of you are willing to make the same choice for Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: After hearing those stories, I made up my mind...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I won't let your journey end here, [Trailblazer]. Somewhere beyond the sky, where Amphoreans have never reached, there are many people waiting for you to come home.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Before stepping into a fate unknown, the last thing I can do... is help you return to your family.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: And even if we ignore the prophecy, we can't go back now.
Lady Trinnon's Century Gate is open on the main street outside Okhema's walls, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Mnemosyne the Guard

rows.text: I'm sorry for making such an unreasonable request of you all. But we live in an imperfect age... where there is never a perfect choice.
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: I have the right to witness the ending of this Trailblaze.
Don't try to stop me from coming back like that.
A hero... doesn't have to bear everything alone.
You've changed into someone different from yourself, Phainon.
Every one of us has the right to make our own choices. If you can't accept my decision on your behalf...
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: ...Then use your choice to open up a new path — that's what you're best at, right?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Regardless... Dan Heng is still holding on for his life... Don't keep him waiting too long, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: One day, I hope we will reunite under the constellations... When that time comes, we can hold a belated victory feast. How about that?
rows.speaker: Phainon

rows.text: Burning skies, shattered statues, corpses strewn everywhere... What a mess. If this is what the inside of "Amphoreus" looks like, it's truly shocking.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: To be honest, I was initially skeptical. But right now, I'm starting to see your point...
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: Screwy.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: If that's the case, Herta, do you now have enough reason to believe my conjecture about the true nature of "Amphoreus"?
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: Let's not expand on that topic just yet. That Intellitron — Lygus, was it? He's not completely dead. That was probably a fake body. Something behind it... is still defying us.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: I must admit, even if both of us worked together, it wouldn't be a simple task piercing through its defenses.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: For now, we can only observe this world as bystanders.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: I knew we should've brought Stephen along.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: No wonder the Garden of Recollection wants to work with the Astral Express — without the power of the Trailblaze, it'd be impossible to unearth this place's secrets. But in the end, the Garden emerged unscathed, and it was the Nameless who got burnt. Curiosity definitely killed Aki.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: That big guy over there — the black ball spewing meteors — you think it's got anything to do with the Lord Ravager?
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: Alas, without sufficient computational power in the stream projection, I am unable to analyze the Path Energy.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: Suggestion: The immediate priority now is to find the whereabouts of the two Nameless. Research priority on the Destruction can be lowered. Every second counts, before that Intellitron's preventative measures kick in.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: All right, all right, stop making a fuss. How many times have we collaborated, and when did it ever not end in a perfect outcome?
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: Why not add another mission objective while we're at it: The card-playing Memokeeper told me that the frozen Trailblazer girl might just also be trapped inside Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: If time allows, I will also investigate March 7th's whereabouts.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: Herta, do you hear that? A wave of desperate cries from the heart of the mountain city. The lives there are undergoing intense suffering.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: Conclusion: The butterfly has already flapped its wings, and an impending storm closes in. The Nameless are important allies, and you and I have matters to attend to, Herta. I beseech you...
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: In moments when a choice needs to be made, one must not be distracted due to personal interests.
rows.speaker: Screwllum's Projection

rows.text: Of course I know that.
