rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: Tsk, fate really is a game of dice, Screwy. Who'd have thought? That thing once sowed chaos across the cosmos, causing the Intelligentsia Guild to splinter and disintegrate. It wasn't until I cracked the solitary waves theory that its lingering effects were put to an end.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: Yet, in a forgotten corner of the cosmos, one slipped through the net and remained operational. And it was this machine that eventually became the cradle for the birth of a certain Lord Ravager...
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: The source of Amphoreus' tragedy...
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: ...is an Emperor's Scepter that survived to this day.
rows.speaker: Herta's Projection

rows.text: This is... what the world looked like originally?
And what are you doing here?
...Answer my question, Lygus.
Ah... Another hero has arrived at the Vortex. I can no longer remember how many times this has happened.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The author of each epic, as the prophecy has foretold, stays their pen at this point.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Just like each cycle of the extrapolation, in accordance to THEIR primordial design, ends here.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: No need to panic, Lord Phainon. I stepped into this space purely for one purpose: To witness the prophecy's Miracle of Genesis.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...You've never expressed interest in the Flame-Chase Journey. When my companions and I ran, bled, and sacrificed for the Coreflames, you never so much as lifted a finger.
An indifferent observer, an Antikytheran who is neutral till the end... Why would you suddenly express concern for the Chrysos Heirs' mission?

When that lone swordmaster left everything behind, plunging into a sea of madness, I was on the shore, listening. When that mighty lord shed his armor, filling the crevices of the earth with his iron bones, I was on the mountain top, gazing down.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Across a thousand years of the Flame-Chase Journey, I have witnessed the ardor, resolve, division, and unity of the Chrysos Heirs with mine own eyes...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Just as you were all born to shoulder the guidance of the prophecy, I too, having bathed in the gaze of distant stars, have seen the deepest, darkest of destinies...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I will become the most loyal reader of the epics, a spectator voraciously consuming the valorous deeds of you heroes.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: "The gaze of distant stars"...?
One day, you will understand. But not now.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: At this moment, please disregard this observer, and finish what you must, Lord Phainon.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I once believed that as long as I chased the flames relentlessly, the fog before me would clear, and fate would reveal its truest form.
But along the way, we... they, all who passed, never once received the justice promised by the prophecy.
I have perceived: Outside the Vortex, the world is collapsing, and the children of humanity are crying.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But you, Lord Phainon, will bury the old world with that Coreflame, bringing all things into a gray unknown...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: It doesn't matter. This cruel Flame-Chase Journey has made me abandon my fantasies. The future is not a paradise with a gentle west wind, waiting for us to step in...
If what lies ahead is a mass of chaos, I will tear it apart...
...Then usher in the first ray of blazing sunlight.
All shall bid farewell to one, and that person alone will witness the miracle. Such is the will of fate.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Yet this time, will an epic with endless cycles...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...Is it you?
...turn a new page?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: ...Of course.
This will be a romantic story like none that has come before...
You think so too, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... you do have a knack for saving the world!
rows.speaker: Phainon
